messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

Thanks. I’m not sure of the exact wording of the will, and we haven’t had an independent valuation. I don’t know whether B wants to sell or what price A is proposing. I haven’t agreed to a discounted purchase; I want a fair share.
I’ll reach out to them both. Let’s get the will and an independent valuation before discussing a price; there’s no rush.

I’m not sure what the will says about the house, and I don’t have a price in mind yet. I’d like to buy it with my husband at a family discount, but I know C hasn’t agreed. An independent valuation sounds fair. B wants money, but I don’t know what for.
I’d probably prefer to sell my share, if we can agree on a fair value. I’m hoping to put the money toward a small dance studio.
Agreed. Let’s confirm the will and get the valuation. I haven’t agreed to a discount; any offer needs to be fair to both B and me.
